paper: Where the Tokens Go: A Measured Anatomy of LLM Agent Trajectory Costs
author: Tommy Tran
selection: All repeat=0 rows with condition baseline or truncate; no selection by success. 144 paired tasks, 288 attempts.
transform: Retain listed per-run totals, runtime grades, submitted/expected answers, and per-step token/model fields; omit other step metadata. No rerun or repricing.
billing_completeness: Unknown: original client used max_retries=5 and logs do not expose SDK-internal attempts or invoices.
grade_reproducibility: Runtime harness grades retained. Saved logs omit final filesystem state, so the write checks cannot be independently rerun from this export.
scope: Single model, synthetic tasks, three task families, 12-step cap; truncate condition caps tool responses at 600 characters.
